examples.name: Sample — a QR code closing a product page
paragraphs: A QR code printed at the foot of a product page, beside the line "Pour découvrir d'autres exemples, c'est ici :" — the prose leads directly into it, so dropping the code leaves a sentence pointing at nothing. The code on this page does not decode, so the alt text stays empty; had it decoded, its payload would fill the alt slot. The code is its own element, with a box around the code alone.
